C1.worst_defect: The hero gives four buttons the same weight ('Live demo', 'Quick start', 'Try with your store', 'GitHub'), and on a phone they wrap into two uneven rows. 'Try with your store' sits beside the others even though the line under it says your store needs the plugin first, so a non-developer can press it and hit a dead end.

C2.worst_defect: The site never says what happens to sales still waiting on the till if the browser's site data is cleared or the device dies before it reconnects. It only says unsent sales are 'kept in SQLite databases inside this browser' and that signing out keeps them. The Limitations page is also silent on a cash drawer: it covers the card terminal, but cash drawers and receipt printers get no mention beyond 'print the receipt from the browser'.
C2.where: limitations.desktop.01; connect-a-till 'Where your data goes'; troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'

C3.worst_defect: The quick start ends with the till signed in as 'your administrator email and password' and never says to make a per-cashier account. That step is only on Connect a till, and it carries a trap: 'The till's order list needs ReadOrder, which that role gains only in the plugin release after 0.3.0; until then, add it to the role yourself.' A developer who follows the quick start leaves staff on an admin login, or on a role that can't see the order list.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.03 step 8a; connect-a-till 'Give each cashier their own account'

C4.worst_defect: Selling offline is the headline promise, yet its only how-to is a one-sentence 'Sell while offline' section inside Troubleshooting, not on At the till. The Troubleshooting notices also repeat the till's message as the action: "...Ask the store owner to look at the sync log in this till's Settings." is followed by 'Ask the store owner to look at the sync log in this till's Settings.' No page explains that sync log.
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01 'Till updates line' and 'Sell while offline'; at-the-till (no offline section)

C5.worst_defect: On every desktop docs page the grey sidebar panel stops at about 900 px with a hard edge, and plain page background runs below it beside the rest of the article. The till screenshots in the hero and on At the till are scaled so small that their labels can't be read.
C5.where: quick-start.desktop.01, at-the-till.desktop.01, limitations.desktop.01 (left column, y≈900); home.desktop.01 hero image

C6.worst_defect: The phone docs' sticky 'On this page' bar starts with a hollow grey ring that looks like a loading spinner ('◯ 1. Install the plugin', '◯ Open the register'), so the page reads as still loading. Long Troubleshooting notices wrap into dense paragraphs that are hard to scan between customers.

C7.worst_defect: The 404 page reuses the home page's sales sentence as its meta description ('Open-source point of sale for Vendure. Sell from the browser...'). The share card's brand mark is an empty circle outline that looks like a placeholder, and the card shows no product image.

overall_worst.defect: The site's headline promise is 'keeps selling when the connection drops', but it never states the risk a shop owner needs to know. Offline sales exist only in that one browser until they send, so clearing site data, a private window or a broken tablet before reconnecting loses them. There is also no plain rule for checking that '0 orders waiting' before the day is closed or the device is swapped.
overall_worst.where: home.desktop.01 'Keeps selling offline'; troubleshooting 'Sell while offline'; limitations.desktop.01
overall_worst.fix: Add one bullet to Limitations and one line to a 'Selling offline' section on At the till: unsent sales live only in this browser until they send, so don't clear site data or swap devices while the header shows orders waiting, and check that it shows none before you close the register.
